fields.Name: T129 - Admin System Diagnostics
fields.Description: Verifies the Admin app's Monitoring > Diagnostics sub-section renders the system diagnostics/health view with status indicators without crashing.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Admin app using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box). Open the 'Monitoring' section, then in its left sub-navigation click the 'Diagnostics' sub-section. The success state is the system diagnostics/health view rendering with status indicators (such as health checks or status badges). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained env - wait for the view to render, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Admin app is active with the Monitoring section open and the Diagnostics sub-section selected in the left sub-navigation
The system diagnostics/health view renders showing status indicators such as health checks or status badges
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
